sentences.text: Shri Siddarth Sharma, counsel for the petitioner.
Shri B.S. Kushwaha, panel lawyer for the respondent State.
Learned panel lawyer for the respondent/State accepts notice on behalf of the State; as such, no further notice is required.
Let record of the Courts below be requisitioned.
Heard on I.A.No.4375/2018, an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of petitioner Pappu Sahu.

A perusal of the record reveals that the petitioner stands convicted under Sections 16 (1) (A) (i) read with section 7 (1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for a period of 6 months and fine in the sum of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation.

It has been submitted on behalf of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been in custody since the date of the judgment of the appellate Court ie. 12.03.2018; therefore, it has been prayed that the jail sentence of the petitioner be suspended.
Learned panel lawyer for the respondent State on the other hand has opposed the application.

However, keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case in their entirety, particularly the fact that the petitioner has been in custody since the date of the judgment of the appellate Court i.e.
12.03.2018 and the quantum of sentence imposed upon him, in the opinion of this Court, this is a fit case for grant of bail to the petitioner and suspend his jail sentence.
IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH PRINCIPAL SEAT AT JABALPUR ( Pappu Sahu vs. State of M.P.)

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.40,000/- with a solvent surety in the same amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 05.10.2018 and on such other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, sentence of the imprisonment awarded to the petitioner shall remain suspended till further orders and he shall be released on bail.
